items.description: About Payoneer Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories. By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence. What you’ll do: This role operates in mix between 1-1 with top clients and a 1-to-many, outbound-led model, managing a large customer portfolio through a combination of automation, lifecycle triggers, and targeted commercial engagement. Manage and grow large pool of existing client relationships, building long-term partnerships with top and mid-tail customers to identify emerging business needs and opportunities. Proactively strengthen and expand relationships to maximize retention, cross-sell, and upsell across the portfolio, increasing customer value and revenue through tailored engagement strategies Perform outbound outreach, including cold calls, identify opportunities, activate customers, and drive commercial outcomes Design and execute multi-channel strategies to reach large customer segments at the right moment in their lifecycle, creating and qualifying opportunities effectively. Drive retention, and cross-selling initiatives. Identify business opportunities and define go-to-market strategies, leveraging customer insights and market learnings. Build success stories, case studies, and business reports to showcase impact and support internal and external alignment. Lead educational initiatives, including webinars and workshops, to drive ongoing engagement within the portfolio. Own the end-to-end commercial process, including demos, proposals, negotiations, and closing long-term agreements. What we’re looking for: Bachelor's degree, preferably in business or engineering Fluent in English and Ukrainian 2+ years of account management, sales, business development or other relevant experience Expertise in developing business cases, financial analyses, and modeling, analyzing and forecasting economic and financial impacts Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to present a business case to key stakeholders High level of organization, focus, and ability to work under pressure Extra Points we need from you: · High-volume- outbound environment experience, comfortable handling large outreach volumes. · Experience with CRM platforms like Sales Force and expertise in sales reporting. · Familiarity with payment industry, ERP; invoicing, reconciliation tools and data-driven platforms. · Proven track record in working with international clients across diverse industries. · Experience selling B2B solutions in a highly consultative manner. The Payoneer Ways of Working Act as our customer’s partner on the inside Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. Do it. Own it. Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. Continuously improve Always striving for a higher standard than our last. Build each other up Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today. We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

items.title: Corporate Travel Consultant
items.summary: CI Azumano is Seneca Holdings' full-service travel management company for businesses, governments, and personal travelers.
items.description: CI Azumano is Seneca Holdings' full-service travel management company for businesses, governments, and personal travelers. We offer 24/7 support for travelers while also supporting customers with travel expense management, policy implementation, technology solutions, business intelligence tools, and vendor negotiations. Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation. CI Azumano is seeking a Corporate Travel Consultant to support our growing team. This position is responsible for providing professional travel service assistance to specific corporate clients with whom CI Azumano has active contracted services arrangements, and in the manner prescribed in active service contracts. Roles and Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Serve as a travel expert and professional guide for contracted corporate clients. Ensure that every facet of the business travel experience (domestic and international) is well planned, adheres to organizational travel policies, and validates that a high quality of accommodation and transportation is secured for the traveler. Conduct exhaustive fact-finding interviews of the traveler or corporate representative to ascertain the particulars of the travel needs, then applies their knowledge of travel systems, airline reservation systems, hotel reservation systems and car rental companies, Amtrak, etc. to secure cost effective travel arrangements. Maintain proper tracking of the status/entries in the main operational queues (Action, Error and Cancel), and initiate steps as prescribed in applicable SOP. Initiate cancellation or reservation change processes to their completion, where applicable, to include expedient client agency notification. Provide updates, as necessary, to client organizations to ensure their full awareness of information and status relating to the pending travel (i.e. itinerary, local customs, passports, Visa’s, certificates of vaccination, and other advisories, etc.). Conduct routine research of travel industry changes, trends and offerings to ensure they are working with the most up-to-date information when advising client agencies. Maintain a superb customer service attitude and demeanor at all times while providing quality service, timely and accurate completion of travel arrangements and recommending value-added services to the client agency. Maintain knowledge and thorough understanding of operational IT systems, processes and practices to ensure consistent performance of routine activities associated with providing high-quality service to client agencies. Serve as backup Consultant for other accounts/clients, as may be assigned. Must be able to work remotely in a separate designated office at home. Basic Qualifications: High School diploma or GED or one to three years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience At least 2 years of experience in arranging domestic and international travel and shall be experienced in using the Global Distribution System Apollo and ticketing software. Proven quality to learn new processes and procedures and effectively apply them to meet the needs of the client or organization. Oral and written communication skills. Knowledge of a GDS, airline travel sites, online booking tools. Outstanding interpersonal and relationship skills. Equal Opportunity Statement: Seneca Holdings provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex/gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, genetic information and/or predisposing genetic characteristics, victim of domestic violence status, veteran status, or other protected class status. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation and training. The Company also prohibits retaliation against any employee who exercises his or her rights under applicable anti-discrimination laws. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company does give hiring preference to Seneca or Native individuals. Veterans with expertise in these areas are highly encouraged to apply. items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

The sectors where we have activities include: telecommunications, finance, industry, utilities, energy, public administration and health. Our mission? Offer technological solutions, business, strategy, development and maintenance of applications, while being a benchmark in consulting. All thanks to the collaboration between teams, the human quality of our people and the fact that we do not conform to what is established, we always seek innovation that brings us closer to the future. Our essence has led us to the forefront of technology, breaking paradigms and providing solutions that truly respond to the needs of each client. Our talent has led us to be one of the top 6 technology companies in the world. Because #Greattech, needs #GreatPeople, like you NTT DATA is looking for high-achieving team players that are quickly adaptable to new challenges and entrepreneurial ventures. We are looking for a Change Management Consultant to work remotely in LATAM with our global clients. Overview: We’re seeking a Change Management Consultant to support the successful delivery of digital transformation initiatives across SAP, Salesforce, data, and AI programs. This role works closely with client stakeholders and technical teams to drive adoption, manage change activities, and ensure business outcomes are realized. The position offers hands-on exposure to a dynamic, client-facing environment with opportunities to lead engagement strategies and deliver measurable impact across organizations. Responsibilities: Define end-to-end Change Management strategy and execution across technology programs. Conduct stakeholder identification, mapping, and engagement planning at all levels. Perform impact assessments across roles, processes, and systems. Define adoption KPIs and measurement frameworks to track success. Design and execute communication strategies and messaging plans. Develop and deliver training and enablement programs for end users. Facilitate workshops and sessions with leadership, teams, and employees. Create and manage change assets including communications, training materials, and plans. Drive adoption activities across discovery, design, testing, and deployment phases. Support UAT, pilot programs, and go-live readiness activities. Partner with technical teams to align change with delivery. Track, analyze, and report adoption metrics and outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor to clients to ensure successful transformation outcomes. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in Change Management within technology-driven transformations. Experience supporting enterprise implementations such as SAP, Salesforce, data, or AI initiatives. Proven ability to execute across the full change lifecycle from strategy to measurement. Strong knowledge of structured Change Management methodologies such as ADKAR. Strong client-facing consulting experience in dynamic environments. Ability to work autonomously and drive results independently. Experience managing stakeholders in large organizations. Excellent communication, facilitation, and storytelling abilities PROSCI ADKAR certification or equivalent Change Management certification preferred. Why NTT DATA? Empowerment and rewards are the cornerstone of our career development model. We are a young, fast-growing company, with a highly innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, because of this professional experience and growth will be unmatched. Our talent and positive attitude allows us to transform our goals into achievements, and projects into realities. NTT DATA is committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise…
items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi AI — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. As a Strategic Account Executive at Bloomreach, you will lead new-business sales in multi-stakeholder environments and manage end-to-end, complex deal cycles. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pricing, negotiation, and close—delivering new revenue across the Spanish market. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and key internal teams, as well as external partners, to open, advance, and win strategic opportunities. Your work will be pivotal in driving our growth in the region. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a targeted cross-regional sales strategy to penetrate key prospects (C-level), acquire new logos, and drive revenue growth Act as the CEO of your territory by assembling and leading a cross-functional virtual team to execute go-to-market strategies, including entering new markets or developing green markets when required. Hand over the deals to the Account Management to ensure a seamless customer experience Qualify leads early and effectively by identifying pain points and matching personas to Bloomreach’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Demonstrate strong proficiency in sales methodologies such as Value-Based Selling, MEDDPICC, or Challenger Sales to navigate complex sales cycles and drive high-value deals. Ensure a robust sales pipeline by maintaining 3x the quarterly target through active prospecting and engaging effectively with C-level clients via various channels, including cold-calls, marketing lead follow-ups, RFPs, professional relationships, local marketing agency contacts, webinars, networking and face-to-face meetings. Collaborate closely with your CEA, channel partner, marketing, enablement, product and customer success teams, to revive old or stalled opportunities, qualify opportunities, and actively mature opportunities consistently Conduct thorough business needs analyses, prepare high-level client briefs, demos, and proposals presenting the unique value proposition of Bloomreach, and explain how it satisfies their needs. Clearly articulate how Bloomreach provides value over competitors and ensures shortlisting for purchasing decisions. Understand the Request for Proposal (RFP) process and influence it early on. Manage the CRM system to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting, maintaining high standards of data hygiene. Multithread to build and maintain solid long-term client relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, offering regular follow-ups and checking in on evolving needs. Provide insights on market trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to improve our product and sales effectiveness. Demonstrate initiative in your role to grow the business. Consistently achieve and exceed new business revenue targets. Act as a mentor or "buddy" for other regions, teams and junior team members. Follow instructions of the manager and complete additional duties as needed. What We’re Looking For: 5+ years years of quota-carrying experience (B2B sales) selling software or software-as-a-service (SaaS) Deep knowledge of MarTech technologies, CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, Search and Merch or data capabilities A proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue quota in a Sales Manager or equivalent role Well-established presence in the local markets with a relevant network The ability to successfully negotiate and close deals in a highly collaborative team environment Detail oriented, relationship-building skills, and a focus on a high level of customer service, having a passion for building rapport with clients and helping their businesses The ability to adapt to new environments and use your own initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including high-calibre presentation skills Excellent time management skills, positive attitude and a “love of selling” The base salary range for this position is €62,000-€77,500. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. #LI-SF1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Base Salary Range €62.000—€77.500 EUR More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.4/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program -- participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000 paid out immediately after the new hire starts. We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

items.description: Principal Data Standards Consultant ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development Principal Data Standard Consultant UK As a Principal Clinical Data Standards Consultant at ICON Plc, you will: Provide expert-level functional knowledge in at least one standards domain, contributing to the development of standards content both internally and for sponsor-facing projects. Develop, implement, and maintain ICON standards libraries in compliance with CDISC, sponsor, and regulatory requirements. Act as a subject matter expert to guide standards implementation and ensure compliance across clinical data management activities. Apply deep understanding of business challenges to recommend and drive best practices , improving processes, products, and services to enhance competitive differentiation. Collaborate cross-functionally to define data collection strategies and standards for clinical trials. Participate in standards governance activities , influencing decision-making and providing expert input on complex topics. Lead or contribute to departmental initiatives , potentially acting as a project lead with responsibility for coordinating team members. Support the development of training materials and reference documentation across standards topics such as CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, Controlled Terminology, define-XML, and regulatory submissions. Stay up to date with industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging standards , ensuring continuous improvement of ICON practices. Provide mentorship and guidance to more junior team members. Requirements: A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Life Sciences, Computer Science, or similar); advanced degrees are advantageous. Approximately 8+ years of experience in clinical data management, with significant expertise in data standards. Advanced proficiency in CDISC standards and strong knowledge of regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, etc.). Proven experience with EDC build/design tools , such as Medidata Rave and/or Veeva Vault CDMS. Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems , using advanced analytical thinking and sound judgment to develop innovative solutions. Strong leadership capabilities, including experience leading initiatives or mentoring team members . Excellent interpersonal, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to present, defend analyses, and secure stakeholder alignment on complex topics . Ability to significantly impact operational, project, or departmental objectives , ensuring delivery of high-quality outcomes aligned with business strategy. If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in the field of clinical data standards and contribute to innovative, high-impact clinical projects, we encourage you to apply and join ICON’s growing team. #LI-JC3 #LI-Remote What ICON can offer you: Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent. In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family. Our benefits examples include: Various annual leave entitlements A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs. Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead. Global Employee Assistance Programme, TELUS Health, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialised professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being. Life assurance Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidised travel passes, health assessments, among others. Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers. At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here . Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles. Are you a current ICON Employee? Please click here to apply

items.description: Requisition #: 18836 Functional Area: Consulting; Workplace Safety Employment Type: Independent Contractor Work Options: Independent Contractor - varies based on Scope of Work #LI-Remote Work Hours: As needed to fulfill contract requirements Posting J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a North American organization providing innovative safety and regulatory compliance guidance and solutions to organizations across the U. S. and Canada. For over 70 years, organizations of all sizes have relied on J. J. Keller to help them create safe work environments for their employees and comply with ever-changing regulations. As we look to expand our service offerings, we are seeking to add an Independent Contractor to our Workplace Safety Consulting practice who has subject matter expertise related to OSHA General Industry . This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor only and does not constitute an employment relationship. Independent Contractors must reside in the U. S. and be legally authorized to perform services within the United States. To be considered as an Independent Contractor, individuals must: Operate as an independent safety consulting business (e.g., sole proprietor, incorporated entity, or equivalent) Provide services to multiple clients and maintain a non-exclusive consulting practice Supply their own tools, methodologies, instructional materials, and business processes necessary to deliver services Be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business-related expenses Provide their own computer, equipment, and tools necessary to perform services Maintain appropriate professional liability coverage, as required under the contractual agreement Travel requirements vary based on client engagements, audit needs, and training delivery, and are defined by project or statement of work. Types of Services Requested Provides expert advice, safety consulting and educational services to J. J. Keller clients on construction safety and health matters through onsite engagements, off-site locations, and/or internet-based delivery methods in accordance with defined project scope. Designs, develops, documents, and maintains training curriculum and instructional materials for general and client-specific applications. Conducts safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments, based on applicable regulatory standards and client requirements related to excavation, fall protection, scaffolding, trenching, heavy equipment, electrical safety, and roadway work zones. Monitors relevant regulatory and compliance applicable to the scope of service and incorporate changes into deliverables and training content as appropriate. Communicates regulatory updates, recommendations, and findings to designated client contacts through reports, briefings, or presentations. Provides advisory support to interpret regulatory requirements and practical application, without assuming responsibility for client compliance enforcement or ongoing operational oversight. Qualifications Experience: Extensive experience in construction safety and health, with a strong focus on OSHA General Industry. Demonstrated expertise providing safety consulting, regulatory advisory, auditing, and training services to commercial or industrial clients. Other Skills/Qualifications : Strong understanding of federal, state, and local safety regulations. Proven history of providing independent safety consulting services within consulting and/or complex corporate environments. Proficiency using business productivity tools (MS Office suite) necessary to deliver reports, presentations, and training materials. Excellent communication skills – verbal, written and presentation Demonstrated ability to work effectively with client representatives at all levels. Maintains a high level of regulatory expertise. Strong working knowledge of sales, marketing, and finance concepts related to operating an independent consulting practice. Ability to legally operate a motor vehicle to perform required services. Physical Requirements Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for extended periods of time. Frequent travel to offsite offices, customer sites and/or industry and training events is required. Travel Requirements: 80% We Protect People & The Businesses They Run™ J. J. Keller History: November 1, 2023, marked 70 years of business for J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. Click HERE to take a tour through three generations of this family-owned business – from our founding as a one-man consulting firm through decades of delivering on our purpose of protecting people and the businesses they run. If you experience system-related issues or need assistance with the online application, please call (920) 720-7700. Professional Referral Program: Not the right role for you, but know someone who could be a great fit? Click HERE to refer them to us through our Professional Referral Program and you will earn a cash payment if your referral is hired. J. J. items.title: Costing and Evaluation Specialist
items.summary: ABOUT YLABSYLabs is a leading global design and research organization designing technologies that amplify youth power, agency, and opportunity.
items.description: ABOUT YLABS YLabs is a leading global design and research organization designing technologies that amplify youth power, agency, and opportunity. Founded in 2014 at the Harvard Innovation Lab, YLabs partners with young people to co-create inclusive digital products and services that improve their lives. Our design process opens spaces where young people’s ideas can become a reality – where they are the architects of the solutions to their most pressing challenges. YLabs multidisciplinary team delivers youth-driven innovation and impact at scale. Our team combines expertise in youth-driven design with adolescent health, climate, livelihoods, digital product design, behavioral science, and epidemiology. Based in Rwanda and the USA, we’ve worked in 18 countries to date on projects spanning three focus areas: optimum health and wellness, improved economic opportunity, and increased climate resilience. Find out more about our projects here: JOB SUMMARY We are seeking a Costing and Evaluation Specialist to support our Climate-SRHR project by leading development of a climate-SRHR cost model for Ethiopia. This position is ideal for someone with strong skills in health program costing, economic evaluation, and health benefit estimation who is looking for flexible, project-based work. Over the course of approximately 55 working days, the Costing and Evaluation Specialist will play a key role in developing a methodologically rigorous cost model structure that is transparent in its assumptions, defensible to donor and government audiences, and replicable as a global public good. In this position, you will work with internal climate change and SRHR technical experts at YLabs , as well as an Ethiopia-based in-country specialist, to provide additional technical input and guidance to ensure the model outputs are relevant, accurate, and meaningful. JOB TYPE This is an independent contractor (Consultancy) position. The position is fully remote. LOCATION This is a fully remote role open to candidates globally. Strong familiarity with Ethiopia’s health system and/or prior experience working with Ethiopian health data is strongly preferred. ABOUT YLABS’ COMPENSATION YLabs adheres to Project Fair’s principles and standards to establish equity in pay with the overriding principle of “equal pay for work of equal value” outlined in the Sustainable Development Goals. All salary ranges are based on level within the organization and are competitive to regional and national salary benchmarks, based on the respective office location. PAY RATE The estimated contract length is 55 days. Compensation is benchmarked to the candidate's region. Indicative ranges: • US: $59–$87.50 USD per hour • Rwanda: $24–$38.50 USD per hour • Other regions: Determined based on local market rates and shared early in the hiring process. YOU WILL: Cost Model Development - 28 Days Lead the design and development of a climate-SRHR cost model for Ethiopia, estimating the incremental cost of climate-proofing existing SRMCH investments Select and apply an appropriate costing methodology (e.g., ingredients-based costing, activity-based costing, or incremental cost analysis), drawing on established frameworks from WHO, the World Bank, or equivalent sources Populate the model using publicly available datasets (e.g., World Bank, WHO UHC Cost-Effectiveness Compendium, DHS) alongside Ethiopia-specific inputs provided by the In-Country Specialist Document all assumptions, data sources, and uncertainty ranges explicitly to ensure the model is transparent and reproducible Collaborate with the YLabs team to refine the cost model approach and ensure technical alignment with established climate-SRHR risks, approaches, and priorities Health Benefit Estimation and ROI Analysis - 23 Days Develop a return-on-investment (ROI) framework estimating the health benefits of climate-adaptive SRMCH interventions compared to a business-as-usual baseline Estimate health outcomes associated with each intervention across a spectrum from light-touch to intensive adaptations, using accepted evaluation and benefit-estimation approaches Model the projected amortization of climate-adaptive SRMCH investments over a 5–10 year window Ensure the ROI logic follows accepted health economics conventions and is structured for replication across other country contexts Collaborate with the YLabs team to refine the health benefit estimation approach and ensure technical appropriateness and comprehensiveness for the intended audience Decision-Support Tool Development - 4 Days Support the YLabs team and in-country specialist to translate model outputs into accessible, actionable tools for Ministry of Health stakeholders and donors, including a tradeoff analysis tool and example implementation roadmaps Document a reusable costing methodology that enables other countries and researchers to replicate and adapt the model Stress-test model outputs with the YLabs team and in-country specialist to ensure results are credible to Ethiopian ministry and donor audiences YOU ARE: Collaborative and integrative, comfortable working with quantitative data, qualitative program inputs, and contextual knowledge from in-country partners to inform your modelling Detail oriented and analytically rigorous, with deep experience building cost models that withstand donor and peer scrutiny Transparent in your methodology, with a habit of documenting assumptions and flagging uncertainty Self-motivated and reliable, able to manage your time and responsibilities independently while contributing to overall team success YOU HAVE: At least 5 years of relevant work experience in SRMNCH health program costing, economic / health evaluation, or a closely related field Demonstrated experience designing and building cost models or cost-effectiveness analyses that have been reviewed by donors, governments, or for publication Demonstrated experience estimating the health benefits / health risks associated with different potential intervention pathways Familiarity with established costing frameworks and data sources, including WHO and World Bank tools Strong organizational and communication skills, including excellent written communication skills in English, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and accessible summaries Strong quantitative and analytical skills, including proficiency in Excel or equivalent modelling tools Basic proficiency with Google Workspace DESIRABLE: Experience working at the intersection of climate change and health, including climate-health costing, climate adaptation investment planning, or related fields. Experience at the intersection of climate change and SRHR is highly desirable. Familiarity with Ethiopia’s health system data and/or prior work on SRMNCH and/or climate programs in Ethiopia Experience working on program design and evaluation for SRHR and/or climate-health programming Prior experience working with international NGO teams, bilateral donors, or multilateral organizations NGOs (e.g., FCDO, Gates Foundation, UNFPA, World Bank) Experience presenting technical findings to government or donor audiences Advanced (graduate-level) training in public health, economics, evaluation, climate adaptation, or another related field. All YLabs offers of employment are conditional on satisfactory background check and criminal record clearances. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY YLabs is committed to building teams and policies that promote equity, justice, and belonging at work. We strongly encourage people from all cultures, races, educational backgrounds, socio-economic classes, sexual orientations, age, gender, and physical abilities to apply. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, familial status, marital status, caregiver status, or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Salary: Compensation is benchmarked to the candidate's region. Indicative ranges: • US: $59–$87.50 USD per hour • Rwanda: $24–$38.50 USD per hour • Other regions: Determined based on local market rates and shared early in the hiring process. Originally posted on Himalayas

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: London, England URL: https://www.mobiloud.com Work location: Remote, anywhere outside the United States Sales territory: North America, UK, and EU Contract type: Full-time contractor Compensation: Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue About MobiLoud MobiLoud helps established ecommerce brands turn their existing websites into iOS and Android apps, without rebuilding their product or running a second system. Our customers use MobiLoud to drive repeat purchases, recover abandoned carts through push notifications, and reduce their dependence on paid acquisition. We're a bootstrapped, profitable, remote-first SaaS company founded in 2013. We've published 2,000+ apps and have hundreds of active customers today, including Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji. Our team is 16 people, all remote and hands-on. The Role Email and SMS still drive revenue for ecommerce brands, but deliverability, SMS compliance, and acquisition costs keep making retention harder. A mobile app gives their best customers another direct channel through push notifications, tied to the website they already operate. That is the sale. You own the close for ecommerce brands across North America, the UK, and Europe. Discovery, demo, proposal, pricing conversations, contracting, and getting the signature on the order form are all part of the job. Most buyers are founders, ecommerce leads, digital directors, and marketing leaders. This is an inbound-led closing role: meetings come mainly from inbound demand, SDR-sourced pipeline, older opportunities, and referrals. You turn the right opportunities into signed customers. This posting is for candidates based outside the United States. You can be anywhere if you can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations. You need to sound natural with North American and European buyers, understand how DTC ecommerce brands think, and learn the mobile app revenue case quickly. What You'll Do • Run discovery with inbound and SDR-sourced prospects • Lead demos tied to the prospect's site, traffic, retention stack, and commercial goals • Build the proposal, pricing case, and ROI narrative • Run pricing and commercial conversations • Manage the contracting process through signature and handoff • Follow up on stalled deals and re-engage older good-fit opportunities • Keep the CRM current, with clear next steps, close dates, and deal notes Who You Are • You have closed B2B deals before and can talk clearly about deal size, sales cycle, buyer type, win rate, objections, and what you personally owned • You have SaaS or software sales experience, ideally with products that require some technical understanding: websites, integrations, ecommerce platforms, apps, implementation, or developer-adjacent work • You have native or near-native English. Written and spoken English both need to feel natural to US, Canadian, UK, and EU buyers • You understand North American business culture, buying expectations, consumer brands, ecommerce, DTC, and how senior buyers like to communicate • You can sell to founders, heads of digital, ecommerce leads, and marketing leaders without sounding scripted • You are comfortable learning both the commercial and technical side of ecommerce: retention, repeat purchase, owned channels, paid acquisition pressure, websites, mobile apps, integrations, and why brands invest in apps • You can work with UK/EU hours and have regular overlap with US East Coast business hours for demos and buyer conversations Compensation • Competitive base plus commissions tied to closed revenue • Full-time independent contractor basis. You invoice monthly and handle your own tax obligations • You may be based anywhere outside the United States. MobiLoud pays in USD Why This Role • You sell to established ecommerce brands with real revenue and clear commercial problems • Direct line to the founder. Deal review, pricing decisions, and feedback happen quickly • You work on apps for brands like Estee Lauder, John Varvatos, Jack & Jones, and Tadashi Shoji • Remote contractor role with competitive USD compensation, commission upside, and no office requirement • Set your own hours and take unlimited time off. Give notice when you're out, that's the only rule Not a Fit If • You are based in the United States • You have not closed B2B deals before • You have not personally sold software or SaaS before • Your English is good but still too formal, scripted, or unnatural for North American buyers • You do not follow ecommerce, DTC brands, North American consumer culture, or how online brands grow • You need close daily management to stay focused How to Apply Email jobs@mobiloud.com with the subject line Account Executive - MobiLoud. Include: • Where you are based, and how your working day overlaps with UK/EU and US East Coast business hours • A recent B2B software or SaaS deal you personally closed: what you sold, who the buyer was, deal size, sales cycle, and what you owned from discovery through signature • How many new-logo B2B deals you personally closed in the last 12 months • One ecommerce or DTC brand you think could sell well through a mobile app, and why • Your CV and LinkedIn profile To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mobiloud-account-executive

Position Purpose: A Home Services Sales Consultant is responsible for selling the Company's exterior and interior products and services to customers. The Sales Consultant's primary responsibility is outside sales visits to customer homes and trade shows. Although sales efforts and incidental activities may take place at a customer's home or through virtual channels, a Sales Consultant will spend the majority of their working time traveling and away from a dedicated office environment. Sales Consultants will travel to customers' homes to make sales calls, assess customer needs, make individually-tailored product recommendations, develop and negotiate customized price quotes, present warranty information and financial options that meet the customer's needs, and maintain/drive profitability. The Sales Consultant will also complete required sales contracts and paperwork, and take measurements using industry-standard methods to ensure orders meet required installation specifications. The Sales Consultant is responsible for proactively soliciting and acquiring new customers inside assigned THD stores and during industry events (such as Home Shows). To drive sales and increase the pipeline of potential customers, a Sales Consultant will travel to their assigned stores, maintain local relationships, educate store associates on HDIS offerings, and bring awareness to HDIS programs. Key Responsibilities: 100% - Customer Service -Travel and engage in outside sales activities, primarily in customers' homes. Conduct professional and compelling sales presentations. Adapt quickly to changing customer needs and effectively advocate HDIS solutions. Conduct incidental activities necessary to complete sales (e.g., assessing customer needs, develop price quotes, measure product specifications, etc.) Present warranty and available financing options to customers. Prepare for appointments, commute to/from appointments and process sales-related paperwork. Prospecting for new customers both inside and outside of assigned THD store and participate in scheduled industry events. Proactively seek out new referrals and develop and maintain relationships with store management and associates. Attend sales and store team meetings to continually improve sales techniques and learn about HDIS product offerings. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: US - California - Thousand Oaks URL: http://amgen.com Career Category Marketing Job Description What you will do Let's do this. Let's change the world. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives everything we do. Within the US Bone Health Business Unit, we have set a bold ambition to help prevent 3 million osteoporotic fractures by 2033 by transforming how osteoporosis is recognized, diagnosed, treated, and prioritized across the healthcare ecosystem. Achieving this ambition requires more than innovative medicines—it requires transforming the osteoporosis ecosystem through stakeholder alignment, disease awareness, innovation, and coordinated action. Bone IMPACT (Igniting Momentum through Policy, Alliances, Communications, and Technology) is Amgen's enterprise above-brand strategy to advance this ambition by mobilizing partners across the healthcare ecosystem and creating the conditions that improve disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. The Marketing Director, Bone IMPACT will lead the evolution of Amgen's enterprise market-shaping strategy for osteoporosis by identifying, prioritizing, and advancing initiatives that transform the future osteoporosis landscape. Working across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, and external stakeholders, this leader will shape strategy, build strategic partnerships, identify emerging opportunities, and align organizational capabilities to accelerate meaningful improvements in osteoporosis care, with the opportunity to build a team and develop talent as the capability expands. This is a unique opportunity to help build one of Amgen's most strategic enterprise capabilities while shaping the future of osteoporosis care for one of the largest and most underserved patient populations in healthcare. Success in this highly visible leadership role requires strategic thinking, influence without authority, external partnership leadership, and the ability to translate bold ideas into executable strategies within a complex, highly regulated environment. Key Responsibilities Lead Enterprise Strategy & Cross-Functional Leadership Develop the long-term Bone IMPACT vision and enterprise strategy aligned with Bone Health business priorities. Identify emerging opportunities that strengthen the osteoporosis ecosystem and accelerate disease awareness, diagnosis, treatment, and fracture prevention. Lead above-brand market-shaping initiatives by aligning priorities across Marketing, Medical, Health Systems, Government Affairs, Corporate Communications, Advocacy, Value & Access, HEOR, and other key functions. Establish governance and integrated planning to align initiatives, partnerships, sponsorships, and investments around shared strategic priorities. Incubate innovative capabilities, evaluate impact, and transition mature initiatives to long-term business owners while identifying new opportunities for growth. Lead National Partnerships & Ecosystem Leadership Build trusted relationships with national medical societies, advocacy organizations, professional associations, health systems, technology companies, policy organizations, and other influential stakeholders. Convene strategic coalitions and partnerships that advance shared priorities through education, advocacy, innovation, and implementation initiatives. Represent Amgen as a trusted enterprise partner committed to advancing the osteoporosis ecosystem. Monitor the external environment to identify new partnerships, collaborations, and market-shaping opportunities. Lead Above-Brand Strategic Communications & Market Activation Develop enterprise above-brand communication and market activation strategies that elevate osteoporosis as a national healthcare priority. Shape evidence-based disease narratives that connect osteoporosis to broader conversations around women's health, menopause, healthy aging, longevity, and fracture prevention. Identify opportunities to leverage strategic communications, public awareness, partnerships, thought leadership, and emerging media to accelerate stakeholder engagement and market transformation. Partner across Brand Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical, Advocacy, Government Affairs, Health Systems, Value & Access, and external agencies to ensure above-brand engagement strategies complement branded marketing while advancing enterprise priorities. Lead the strategy—and, as appropriate, the development and execution—of enterprise above-brand awareness and market activation initiatives. Lead Innovation & Future Market Development With cross-functional partners, evaluate emerging trends, AI-enabled capabilities, technologies, and strategic partnerships to identify new opportunities that transform osteoporosis awareness, patient engagement, and care delivery. Translate external insights into business cases, pilot initiatives, and scalable enterprise strategies. Foster a culture of innovation by identifying opportunities that position Bone IMPACT to address future market needs. Measure Impact & Optimize Strategy Define success measures that evaluate ecosystem impact, stakeholder engagement, partnership effectiveness, market activation, and strategic progress. Monitor performance and refine enterprise priorities based on market insights and measurable outcomes. Manage agency partners, external vendors, and program budgets to maximize impact and return on investment. Present strategic recommendations, market insights, and enterprise progress to senior leadership to inform business decisions and future investment priorities. <>· What we expect of you We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic leader we seek is an enterprise thinker who thrives in ambiguity, builds trusted partnerships, and mobilizes diverse stakeholders to create meaningful change across the healthcare ecosystem. Basic Qualifications Doctorate degree and 4 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience OR Master's degree and7 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience OR Bachelor's degree and 9 years of marketing, communications, public affairs, advocacy, commercial, medical, or related biotechnology experience Preferred Qualifications MBA, MPH, MHA, or other advanced degree. 10+ years of progressively increasing responsibility within biotechnology, healthcare, advocacy, communications, consulting, or related industries. Demonstrated success developing enterprise or above-brand strategies that influence healthcare markets beyond individual products. Experience building strategic partnerships with national medical societies, advocacy organizations, health systems, policy organizations, technology companies, or other influential stakeholders. Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior leaders without direct authority. Understanding of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem, including health systems, policy, advocacy, population health, quality improvement, and value-based care. Experience leading strategic communications, public awareness, advocacy, stakeholder engagement, or market activation initiatives within healthcare or other highly regulated industries. Demonstrated ability to identify emerging opportunities and translate insights into innovative strategies and executable business plans. Demonstrated ability to develop market-shaping strategies while navigating legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements. Strong executive presence with exceptional communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills. Proven ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and deliver results across multiple complex initiatives. Experience leading agencies, external partners, and cross-functional teams to achieve measurable business and patient impact. . items.title: Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results
items.summary: Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kig
items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/iisd-consultancy-for-the-design-and-production-of-four-animated-videos-showcasing-suncasa-s-achievements-and
